content.introduction: GeekWire is a technology news website based in Seattle that covers startups and established tech companies. Founded in 2011 by Todd Bishop and John Cook, it provides news, resources, and analysis for the Pacific Northwest tech community. Recent coverage includes updates on tech moves, new office openings, and initiatives to diversify the Seattle economy. The site also offers resources like GeekWork recruiting, GeekWire 200 startup ranking, and the Startup List database.

What happens here matters everywhere.

# About GeekWire

GeekWire is a fast-growing, national technology news site with strong roots in the Seattle region and a large audience of loyal, tech-savvy readers around the globe. Founded in 2011, GeekWire is uniquely positioned to cover some of the most widely followed and innovative tech companies in the world, and one of the most vibrant startup markets in the country.
